item.title: UK PM Starmer opposes tariffs on allies, advocates for dialogue and partnership
item.description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer said tariffs should not be used against allies and warned that a trade war would be in no one’s interest, as he emphasized partnership, dialogue and respect for international law in comments addressing rising geopolitical and economic tensions, according to Reuters.

item.title: CBT survey shows inflation expectations stuck near 23% – Commerzbank
item.description: CBT’s latest survey shows market participants holding a 23.2% inflation forecast for end-2026; this compares with 23.4% a month ago.

item.title: GBP: UK data may boost Sterling amid short squeeze – ING
item.description: November jobs and December CPI data could provide a modest boost to sterling, potentially extending a short squeeze that has been building since late November.

item.title: Pound Sterling gains against a weakened US Dollar over Greenland's disputes
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) trades 0.15% higher to near 1.3400 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: China hits 5% growth target, but domestic weakness persists – Commerzbank
item.description: The Chinese economy grew by 5% last year – but this should come as no surprise to anyone. After all, this was the goal of the Chinese Communist Party, and Xi Jinping had already mentioned a few weeks ago that the growth target had been achieved.

item.title: USD/INR reclaims all-time high amid continuous foreign outflows
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) demonstrates weakness against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair jumps to near the all-time high of 91.55 as the Indian currency continues to underperform its peers.
